Compare audit analysis strategies

Source: R/strategy-compare.R
catmech_compare_strategies.Rd

Fits a user-specified regression model across multiple audit analysis strategies on a dataset with recorded values and an audit reference subsample:

  1. Validation subsample: Audited records only (discards un-audited recorded values).

  2. Naive analysis: Trusts un-audited recorded values as correct without audit adjustment.

  3. Linear Multiple Imputation: Calibrates un-audited values given recorded values ([catmech_reference(use_recorded = TRUE)]).

  4. Contamination Model: Imputes un-audited values under a reference-calibrated error model ([catmech_contamination()]).

Usage

catmech_compare_strategies(
  data,
  value,
  reference,
  formula,
  predictors = NULL,
  family = stats::gaussian(),
  m = 10L,
  seed = 123L,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  agreement_tol = 1,
  cluster = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing analysis variables, recorded values, and audit references.

value

Character string naming the recorded value column.

reference

Character string naming the audit reference column (with `NA` for un-audited rows).

formula

Model formula for the downstream analysis (e.g. `outcome ~ lab_value + age`).

predictors

Character vector of predictor column names to include in the imputation models. If `NULL`, every variable in `formula` other than `value` and `reference` is used, including the outcome. When the audited value is an analysis predictor, leaving the outcome out of the imputation model biases its coefficient toward zero; a supplied vector without the outcome draws a warning from the pooling step.

family

Error distribution and link function for GLM (default [stats::gaussian()] for linear models; use [stats::binomial()] for logistic regression).

m

Number of completed datasets to impute (default 10L).

seed

Random seed for reproducible imputation (default 123L).

conf_level

Confidence level (default 0.95).

agreement_tol

Tolerance for agreement audit in contamination model (default 1.0).

cluster

Optional complete cluster column. Every strategy then uses a cluster-robust variance with complete-data degrees of freedom of clusters minus one: the delete-one-cluster jackknife for linear models, as in [catmech_pool_lm()], and the CR1S sandwich for other families, as in [catmech_pool_glm()]. It is not passed to `catmech_reference(cluster = )`, whose clustered imputation biased slopes toward zero in simulations when the audited value was a predictor (`validation/VARIANCE_MI_SYNTHESIS.md`); a formula term naming the same column is still used as an ordinary predictor.

...

Currently unused.

Value

An object of class `c("catmech_strategy_comparison", "data.frame")` containing:

strategy

Strategy label (`validation_subsample`, `naive_trust_recorded`, `linear_mi_recorded`, `contamination_model`).

term

Model coefficient term.

estimate

Point estimate.

std.error

Standard error.

df

Degrees of freedom.

lower, upper

Confidence interval bounds.

ci_width

Confidence interval width (upper - lower).

rel_efficiency

Relative precision (inverse variance ratio) relative to the validation subsample.

n_total, n_audited

Total observations and audited records count.

The imputation predictors used are stored in the `imputation_predictors` attribute. If the contamination model fails, its rows are `NA` and a warning gives the reason.

Examples

set.seed(123)
n <- 50
df <- data.frame(
  outcome = stats::rnorm(n, 10, 2),
  lab = stats::rnorm(n, 5, 1),
  age = stats::rnorm(n, 50, 10)
)
df$ref <- df$lab + stats::rnorm(n, 0, 0.2)
df$ref[16:n] <- NA
comp <- catmech_compare_strategies(df, value = "lab", reference = "ref",
                                   formula = outcome ~ lab + age, m = 2, seed = 1)
print(comp)
#> -- Catmech Audit Strategy Comparison --
#> Cohort Size (N): 50 | Audited Records (n): 15 (30.0% audit fraction)
#> Imputation predictors: outcome, age
#> 
#>              strategy        term estimate std.error ci_width rel_efficiency

#>  validation_subsample         lab   0.3596    0.6044   2.6339         1.0000
#>  validation_subsample         age   0.0195    0.0639   0.2785         1.0000
#>  naive_trust_recorded (Intercept)  10.1927    2.1990   8.8477         4.0209
#>  naive_trust_recorded         lab  -0.0657    0.3017   1.2140         4.0128
#>  naive_trust_recorded         age   0.0045    0.0276   0.1111         5.3562
#>    linear_mi_recorded (Intercept)   9.8453    2.8575  15.3433         2.3813
#>    linear_mi_recorded         lab  -0.0121    0.4368   2.8823         1.9145
#>    linear_mi_recorded         age   0.0062    0.0278   0.1123         5.2680
#>   contamination_model (Intercept)  10.1765    2.2185   8.9360         3.9505
#>   contamination_model         lab  -0.0629    0.3059   1.2323         3.9030
#>   contamination_model         age   0.0046    0.0276   0.1112         5.3567
